name: net_desync_results_report
description: A session's networked match ends desynced: the results plate keeps its title and the line of the match (mode, where it stopped: here before the first wave, time) and adds one plain line, that the games disagreed and the match was stopped, with a Show report button (Save report in the browser) instead of Godot's user:// path. The connection overlay and the party strip leave the title to the results (the session's link is kept, as Session does).

steps.assert: node('ResultsTitle').text == 'THE LANDS FELL OUT OF STEP'
node('ResultsDetail').text.contains(' · stopped before the first wave · ') and not node('ResultsDetail').text.contains(' waves · ') and not node('ResultsDetail').text.contains('report')
steps.msg: the line of the match says where it stopped, not how many waves the mode has

steps.assert: node('ResultsReport').text == 'The games disagreed, so the match was stopped. A report was saved.'
steps.msg: one plain line says what happened
and a button shows the report's file
no user:// path on the plate
the overlay stands down under the results
and the party strip leaves the title to the results
